meaning: Return EFI_UNSUPPORTED from the optional featenabler TA acquisition helper. The original caller records feature status 2 and skips gated callbacks, retaining protocol registration and ABL hardware state.
evidence: v10 feature TA and debug-policy SMC requests fail. Helper 0x2370 tries featenabler_a at 0x2448, featenabler at 0x2460 and an embedded TA at 0x2484. Caller 0x154C branches on nonzero to 0x1554, records status 2 and skips to 0x1600.
limitations: Optional secure feature gates are deferred, not successfully enabled. The framebuffer is inherited from ABL. This is an explicit second-stage policy and does not claim that QSEE was repaired.
